decisions.reason: We keep Product A because it extends our established laser-marking portfolio, has remained on the website across two years, and our prior development and market-introduction effort makes management inclined to continue rather than reverse course quickly.

We keep Product B because it is close to our core coding business, has been given its own product page in both 2023 and 2024, and this visible commitment supports continued backing while the growing market develops further.
We keep Product C because it is another core high-resolution inkjet platform with dedicated web presentation over two years, so our investment, responsibility and strategic fit all favor persistence.

We keep Product D because industrial laser marking systems are central to our announced move toward production-wide identification and traceability, and placing them on the home page signals a strong public commitment that management is unlikely to unwind early.

We keep Product E because it was newly launched in 2024 with a specific public announcement, is closely tied to our laser-marking competence, and any early market uncertainty can still be attributed to normal ramp-up effects.

We keep Product F because it builds on our marking technology in a specialized industrial application, has already received an external award at a major trade fair, and our recent investment gives management little reason to withdraw now.
